summary: The filing is a Form 6-K announcing that Sound Group Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. This is a routine regulatory filing with no special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrt management change. The press release simply notifies shareholders of the availability of the annual report, which contains audited consolidated financial statements. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor is mentioned. The event is standard issuer compliance with SEC reporting requirements.
